patch_description: Probe radius_scale=1.2 while retaining velocity. Development mean errors at scales 1.0, 1.25 and 1.5 suggest testing near 1.25; a slightly smaller radius may preserve its gains while reducing relocation disruption. This single-variable refinement avoids unsupported reset conditions. Closed-loop outcomes need not vary smoothly, so improvement remains untested and any transfer claim requires the separate probe.
